room_rent.note: Base plan (Plan 1 & 2) covers General Ward only. Private Room or at-actuals available via optional 'Room Category Modification Option' or inbuilt in Plus/Prime plans.

icu.note: ICU charges covered as part of inpatient care up to Sum Insured; no separate sub-limit or cap stated in the wording.

copayment.note: Zero mandatory co-payment on all base benefits. A 10% co-payment applies only if required intimation timelines are not met (non-intimation co-pay). Global Health Cover (optional) carries a mandatory 10% co-pay.

sub_limits.display: Non-surgical procedures sub-limited; Surrogate/Oocyte donor ₹5L cap
sub_limits.note: Sub-limit for Non-Surgery or Non-Surgical Procedures (equal to or less than Base SI, selectable). In-patient hospitalisation for Surrogate Mother and Oocyte Donor each capped at ₹5L. No sub-limits on surgical inpatient care.

deductible.note: Base plan has nil deductible. Optional aggregate deductible of ₹25k/₹50k/₹1L/₹2L/₹3L/₹4L/₹5L can be chosen. Daily deductible of ₹2,000/day also available as optional cover.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses. Can be reduced to nil via pre-policy health check-up (Option 2) subject to underwriting.

ped_waiting.note: Standard PED waiting period is 36 months. Can be reduced to 24/12/0 months via pre-policy or post-policy health check-up subject to underwriting outcomes.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Standard specific disease/procedure waiting period is 24 months. Can be reduced to 12 months or nil via health check-up subject to underwriting. Nil if Option 2 (pre-policy check-up) is chosen, unless specified in schedule.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18). However, in-patient hospitalisation for Surrogate Mother (complications only, up to ₹5L) is available as optional cover (Section 4.12) for 3-year policies. Normal maternity/delivery not covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: AccumulatePlus optional cover adds 25% or 50% of Base SI per renewal year (irrespective of claims) up to 100% of Base SI. Not available if Non-Surgical sub-limit is in effect. Not available inbuilt in Plan 1 or Plan 2.

restoration.note: Revive benefit restores Base SI unlimited times per policy year upon complete or partial utilisation. Triggered after first claim. Not available if Non-Surgical sub-limit is in effect. Optional in Plan 1 & 2; inbuilt in Plus & Prime.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for up to 60 days before admission.

post_hosp.note: Base cover is 90 days post-discharge. Extendable to 180 days via optional cover 'Enhance Post-Hospitalisation Medical Expenses' (inbuilt in Plus & Prime plans).

day_care.note: Comprehensive list of day-care procedures in Annexure 3 covering ENT, ophthalmology, oncology, urology, gynaecology, general surgery, orthopaedics, paediatric surgery and others.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation is an optional cover (Section 4.10), available only at Preferred Provider Network. Several conditions excluded (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, etc.).

ayush.note: Alternative/AYUSH treatments (Ayurveda, Unani, Sidha, Homeopathy) covered as inpatient at recognised AYUSH hospitals up to Sum Insured (Section 3.8).

organ_donor.note: Living organ donor inpatient expenses for harvesting covered up to Sum Insured (Section 3.5), subject to conditions.

ambulance.note: Domestic road ambulance covered up to Sum Insured (Section 3.6). Emergency air ambulance available as optional cover up to Sum Insured.

modern_treatments.note: Section 3.9 covers robotic surgeries, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemotherapy, immunotherapy, deep brain stimulation, HIFU, balloon sinuplasty, etc. Consumables for robotic surgery excluded.

consumables.note: List-I non-medical/consumable items (gloves, masks, diapers, etc.) excluded by default. Covered if optional 'Non-Medical Expenses Cover' (Section 4.8) is opted at selected provider network.

global_cover.note: Global Health Cover (Section 4.2) covers emergency inpatient treatment outside India up to Base SI or ₹1Cr (whichever lower). Planned treatments, cancer, orthopaedic diseases (except fractures/injuries) excluded. 10% mandatory co-pay.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no look-back applied; claims not contestable except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 30 days for yearly/half-yearly/quarterly premium modes and 15 days for monthly instalment mode.

free_look.note: Free-look period of 30 days from receipt of policy document, applicable only at inception (not on renewals or porting).

portability.note: Portability allowed as per IRDAI guidelines; continuity credits for waiting periods transferred.

notable_exclusions.display: OPD treatment, hormone replacement therapy, sleep disorders, STIs (non-HIV), external congenital anomaly, dental (non-accident), non-network hospitals (except emergencies), maternity

optional_riders.display: Global cover (emergency), AccumulatePlus (NCB), Revive (restoration), Domiciliary, Air ambulance, Non-medical expenses, Room upgrade, Personal accident, Hospital daily cash, Surrogate/Oocyte donor cover
